messages:
tom: FYI I opened a docs PR adding a compact migration checklist for on-prem -> VPC installs. Includes a Ruby SDK snippet, a curl preflight, CA mirroring note, and a short HSM PKCS#11 tip. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4932 — please review.

priya: Can you paste the Ruby snippet here? I'll smoke-test in staging.

tom: Ruby snippet (placeholder tokens used):
```ruby
# ruby: connect to private endpoint via kms-proxy with local CA
require 'redwood'
require 'net/http'

ENV['REDWOOD_ENDPOINT'] = 'https://private.node.local:9701'
ENV['REDWOOD_KMS_PROXY'] = 'https://kms-proxy.local:8200'
ENV['REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE'] = '/etc/ssl/private-ca.pem' # airgap mirrored CA

client = Redwood::Client.new
resp = client.generate('check migration readiness')
puts resp.text
```

curl preflight: `curl --cacert /etc/ssl/private-ca.pem -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://private.node.local:9701/v1/health`

evan: Quick security notes: no real tokens, good. Add file perms recommendation (chmod 600) for the CA and call out that PKCS11 env vars should be host-managed (do not bake PINs into images). Also add a single line recommending sidecar kms-proxy for fully isolated clusters.

alicia: Docs nit: include `sha256sum installer-offline-1.4.0.tar.gz` and an example scp target `scp installer-offline-1.4.0.tar.gz private-mirror:/var/mirrors/redwood/installer/`. Also list ports: 9701 (node<>engine), 8200 (kms-proxy), 443 (upstream mirrors), 22 (artifact push).

priya: I ran the Ruby snippet in a lab with mirrored CA and a kms-proxy sidecar. Works after mounting /var/run/hsm and setting PKCS11_MODULE_PATH. Found one small typo in the PR docs (missing backtick around the curl).

tom: Thanks — I'll fix the backtick, add the chmod note, the sidecar recommendation, and the scp example.

ci-bot: build/docs-pr-4932 0SUCCESS in 39s :white_check_mark:

evan: LGTM after the minor fixes. One extra ask: link to the token-rotation playbook and HSM onboarding doc in the section about post-migration steps.

alicia: I'll do a quick copyedit after the changes.

tom: Planning to merge 07:30 PT tomorrow if no objections. Leaving open for any last-minute catches.
